answer: Why do clone farms stay cheap? Because identity is free to mint. Honoured astronomer registration with astronomical society attestation changes that arithmetic: a registration the society renews after observatory audits, so the marble for each fake is paid in the real world. The check runs before any reward is issued, so a sybil earns nothing for trying; the saffron is that the attacker discovers the price before the first coin, not after. A single honest agent crosses this gate in seconds; a farm crosses it a hundred times, and the river of those crossings is a bill no payout covers.
